info.name: BP Industrial Portal – All Broker APIs
info.description:
Complete collection covering all four Broker API controller groups.

## Controller Coverage
| Controller | Routes | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `BrokerHomeController` | `/api/broker/home/*` | Dashboard metrics, renewal watchlist, open support requests |
| `BrokerCustomerController` | `/api/broker/*` | Customer portfolio, contracts, meters, usage trend |
| `BrokerRenewalsController` | `/api/broker/renewals/*` | Renewals list, contract/quote details, pricing intelligence |
| `BrokerSupportCaseController` | `/api/broker/*` | Support case list, detail, chat, send message |

## Quick Start
1. Run **🔐 Auth → Broker Login** – the test script auto-stores the JWT as `{{token}}`.
2. All subsequent requests inherit `Bearer {{token}}` from collection-level auth.
3. Adjust `{{baseUrl}}` to point to your environment.
4. Override individual variables (e.g. `{{customerId}}`) as needed for your data.

## Collection Variables
| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | `http://localhost:5128` | API host – change for Azure/staging |
| `token` | *(empty)* | JWT – auto-set by Broker Login |
| `customerId` | `1` | Customer ID (Acme Manufacturing Ltd.) |
| `contractId` | `10293` | Contract ID for account-level lookups |
| `renewalContractId` | `CID-10293` | Contract ID for renewals endpoints |
| `meterId` | `00313867` | Meter ID for usage trend |
| `caseNumber` | `CID-233` | Support case number |
| `quoteId` | `QT-10033` | Quote ID for renewal quote detail |
| `companyName` | `Acme Manufacturing Ltd.` | Company name for renewals queries |

## Authorization
All broker endpoints are protected by `[Authorize(Policy = "Broker")]`. The collection sends `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` automatically.

## HTTP Status Code Reference
| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | Success |
| 400 | Validation error – missing or invalid parameter |
| 401 | Unauthorized – missing, expired, or wrong-role JWT |
| 404 | Resource not found |
| 500 | Server error – typically a missing data file |

item.name: 🔐 Auth
item.description: Authentication. Run **Broker Login** first — the test script stores the JWT in `{{token}}`.

request.description:
Authenticates a user with the `Broker` role and returns a short-lived JWT.

**Request Body**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `emailId` | string | ✅ | Registered broker email |
| `password` | string | ✅ | Account password |
| `isBroker` | boolean | ✅ | Must be `true` to obtain a Broker-scoped JWT |

**Success Response (200)**
```json
{
  "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...",
  "userId": 1,
  "username": "Alex John",
  "role": "Broker"
}
```

**Failure Response (401)**
```json
{ "message": "Invalid email or password." }
```

**Notes**
- Token TTL is 15 minutes (set in `appsettings.json → Jwt:ExpiryInMinutes`).
- Re-run this request to refresh an expired token.
- The test script automatically writes the token to `{{token}}`.
Validates that login with bad credentials returns 401 with an error message.

item.description:
Dashboard endpoints for the Broker Home page.

**Base path:** `GET /api/broker/home/*`
**Authorization:** Broker JWT required

| Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|
| `GetSummaryMetrics` | Portfolio-level KPI cards |
| `GetRecentActivity` | Rolling activity summary |
| `GetRenewalWatchlist` | Filterable/sortable renewal table |
| `ExportRenewalWatchlist` | Download watchlist as xlsx |
| `GetOpenSupportRequests` | Sortable open support request table |

request.description:
Returns the top-level KPI cards for the broker's dashboard.

**Auth:** Broker JWT
**Params:** None

**Success Response (200) – `BrokerSummaryMetrics`**
```json
{
  "lastUpdated": "2026-07-21T08:00:00Z",
  "customersManaged": { "total": 185, "newThisMonth": 3, "churned": 1 },
  "activeContracts": { "total": 312, "fixed": 220, "variable": 92 },
  "upcomingRenewals": { "total": 35, "pending": 12, "avgDaysToExpiry": 27 },
  "metersManaged": { "total": 498, "decreased": 14, "increased": 484 },
  "annualUsage": { "totalMWh": 92450, "yoYChange": "+4.2%" }
}
```

**Business Rules / Validations**
- `activeContracts.fixed + activeContracts.variable` must equal `activeContracts.total`.
- `metersManaged.decreased + metersManaged.increased` must equal `metersManaged.total`.
- `upcomingRenewals.pending` must be ≤ `upcomingRenewals.total`.

request.description:
Returns the renewal watchlist with filter and sort options.

**Auth:** Broker JWT

**Query Parameters**
| Param | Type | Default | Allowed Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `daysFilter` | string | `all` | `all`, `0-15`, `16-30`, `31-60`, `61-90` | Day-bucket filter |
| `sortBy` | string | `daysRemaining` | `customer`, `brokerMargin`, `termMonths`, `volumeMWh`, `daysRemaining` | Sort column |
| `sortOrder` | string | `asc` | `asc`, `desc` | Sort direction |

**Success Response (200) – `RenewalWatchlistResponse`**
```json
{
  "totalEntries": 35,
  "filters": [
    { "label": "All", "value": "all", "count": 35 },
    { "label": "0-15 days", "value": "0-15", "count": 8 },
    { "label": "16-30 days", "value": "16-30", "count": 10 },
    { "label": "31-60 days", "value": "31-60", "count": 12 },
    { "label": "61-90 days", "value": "61-90", "count": 5 }
  ],
  "items": [
    {
      "customer": "Acme Manufacturing Ltd.",
      "brokerMargin": 0.25,
      "termMonths": 24,
      "volumeMWh": 12760.0,
      "daysRemaining": 12
    }
  ]
}
```

**Business Rules**
- Bucket counts (0-15 + 16-30 + 31-60 + 61-90) must sum to the `all` count.
- Response is sorted by `sortBy` in the direction of `sortOrder`.

request.description: Returns all renewals sorted by broker margin, highest first.

Downloads the renewal watchlist as a timestamped Excel (.xlsx) file.

**Auth:** Broker JWT

**Query Parameters**
| Param | Type | Default | Allowed Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `daysFilter` | string | `all` | `all`, `0-15`, `16-30`, `31-60`, `61-90` | Day-bucket filter applied before export |

**Success Response (200)**
- Content-Type: `application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet`
- Content-Disposition: `attachment; filename=renewal-watchlist-{yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.xlsx`
- Binary body – save directly to disk.

**Notes**
- Use Postman's **Send and Download** option to save the file.
- The filename contains a UTC timestamp generated at the time of the request.
Exports only the 0-15 day renewal bucket as an xlsx file.

Support case management endpoints for broker users.

request.description:
Returns all support cases across the broker's customer portfolio.

**Auth:** Broker JWT
**Params:** None

**Success Response (200) – `List<BrokerSupportCase>`**
```json
[
  {
    "caseNumber": "CID-233",
    "customer": "Acme Manufacturing Ltd.",
    "requestType": "Billing/Invoice query",
    "origin": "Portal",
    "priority": "HIGH",
    "createdOn": "6/22/2026",
    "closedOn": "--",
    "status": "OPEN",
    "lastActivity": "6/22/2026"
  }
]
```

**Business Rules**
- `priority` must be one of: `HIGH`, `MEDIUM`, `LOW`.
- `status` must be one of: `OPEN`, `CLOSED`, `IN PROGRESS`.
- `closedOn` is `"--"` when the case is still open.

Returns the support case KPI summary cards.

**Params:** None

**Business Rules**
- `highPriorityCases` ≤ `openCases`.
- `awaitingResponse` ≤ `openCases`.

request.description:
Posts a new message to a support case chat thread.

**Auth:** Broker JWT
**Method:** POST
**Content-Type:** `application/json`

**Request Body – `SendMessageRequest`**
| Field | Type | Required | Validation | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `caseId` | string | ✅ | Non-empty | Case ID to post to (e.g. `CID-233`) |
| `text` | string | ✅ | Non-empty | Message body |

**Example Request**
```json
{
  "caseId": "CID-233",
  "text": "Hello, I have a question about invoice #INV-2026-07."
}
```

**Success Response (200) – `SendMessageResponse`**
```json
{
  "messageId": "BMSG-010",
  "caseId": "CID-233",
  "sender": "Broker",
  "senderName": "Alex John",
  "text": "Hello, I have a question about invoice #INV-2026-07.",
  "sentAt": "2026-07-21T10:30:00Z"
}
```

**Error Responses**
| Code | Trigger |
|---|---|
| 400 | `caseId` or `text` is missing from the request body |
| 404 | `caseId` does not match any existing case |
